title: Agent Response Start
description: Payload of the stream:agent_response_start envelope. Sent to every connected client when the AgentCore harness begins streaming an assistant response, so each client can open a new message bubble before the first token arrives.

conversationId.description: ULID of the conversation the response belongs to.

turnId.description: ULID of the agent turn. Matches the turn the Session State Manager opened for undo position tracking.

messageId.description: ULID the assembled assistant message will be persisted under, so a client can reconcile the streamed text with conversation history.
